notes: Re-judged at HEAD against pin ba5ccf5 (prior slides verdict PASS at that pin). Diff-region cause: `## Say what done-done means` (new chunk 5, raw lines 26-39) was inserted between the `Start here` chunk (4) and the two closing-lecture include-links, which used to sit inside `Start here`'s own chunk. That insertion silently orphans a pre-existing, previously-correct spatial pointer in chunk 4 — a rule-12 regression the diff did not touch textually but did break structurally. Two runtime-fork branches at the closer, same as the prior instance: chunks 9-10 (flag:no-module:spot-gaps-build-the-loop) vs chunks 12-14 (flag:module:spot-gaps-build-the-loop) are mutually exclusive alternatives, never co-present in one render; both forks were read for their own internal sequential coherence (0-8,11,9,10 and 0-8,11,12,13,14). Maintainer block read in full: two accept-notes found (`accept_notes_found`), neither covers the chunk-4/chunk-5 interaction below. `node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file <this file> --report` returns clean (only 'the bullets back' at line 58, maintainer-attested) because its OBJ word list does not include 'lecture' — the mechanical gate has a vocabulary gap here; this is a genuine miss caught only by the sequential hand-read the template requires, not a false positive against the tool's silence. Confirmed against ba5ccf5's own recorded instance: that file's rule-1 evidence explicitly said 'chunk 4 line 24 "the lecture below" resolves within the same chunk (lines 26/28 carry the two lecture links) — see rule 12' — i.e. the prior PASS was conditioned on exactly the adjacency this diff removed. `Key Concepts` (chunk 8) gained a fifth bullet ('The verifier, the reference artefact and the plan are compounding...') that the file's own maintainer note (raw line 134, 2026-08-15) declares a four-line, verbatim, closed block — a `check_writing.md` §3 / maintainer-currency question, not a `check_slides.md` rule, so out of this class's lane on principle. Moot as of this read regardless: a neighbour session landed a working-tree edit on this exact file WHILE this judge was running (uncommitted, on top of already-committed db2a68a4 'M5 Key Concepts: the verifier, reference and plan are compounding too'), adding a dated note at the same location acknowledging the block is five lines now and the 2026-08-15 note is stale on the count — body_sha above reflects the file including that concurrent edit. Confirms the observation was correct; the maintainer-currency fix is already in hand from elsewhere and needs no action from this instance. Slide-size (`--report`) shows 12 composed slides, 0 oversized, new chunk 5 at 119w/0b — comfortably under cap. `check-slide-numbering.js` and `check-slide-deixis.js` both exit clean on the file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Considered and cleared as a rule-1 candidate: chunk 4 (Start here) line 22 'the lecture below hands you the lenses to read it with' is a plain cataphoric pointer ('a lecture is coming') whose noun class ('lecture') is self-describing and needs no prior antecedent — unlike the compendium's own 'Never named' example ('before the three things get named', a specific enumerated promise), this is ordinary forward narration, and the compendium's own worked distinction ('the failure modes above' passes §1, fails §12) puts this exact shape — resolvable concept, broken spatial claim — on the §12 side of the line, not §1's. Scored there instead; see rule 12 (REVISE). Chunk 5 line 30 'This one runs in the session you sent off' resolves two lines later in the SAME chunk when the actual prompt block appears (line 32) — ordinary 'answer this:' discourse structure, not a stranded referent. Chunk 8 line 65 'the public field' is covered by the file's own maintainer accept-note (raw line 134: the four/five Key Concepts lines map to the three theory slides in `lectures/what-packaging-is.md`, reminders of content taught there, not new terms needing in-file naming). Chunk 9 line 76 'the kit' and chunk 10 line 84 'the map' are arc-earned spine vocabulary (kit named across M1-M5 per `curriculum/vocabulary.md`; 'the map' is this training's recurring spine figure, and chunk 10's own header — 'Back to the map, one last time' — re-earns it in-chunk regardless).

Closest candidate: chunk 7 line 58 'In the two closing lectures, the headings carry the claims' names the referent by function (the two closing lectures) not by file position, and the two lecture links (lines 60, 62) sit in the same chunk immediately after. New chunk 5's `{{prompt:ae101-m5-done-done}}` and its framing prose stay entirely within this file; no 'the opening lecture said...'-style unnamed cross-file callback appears anywhere in the body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 4 "Start here": line 22: "the lecture below hands you the lenses to read it with." At pin ba5ccf5 this was true on the projected slide — the two lecture include-links ('[Lecture: Reading the return]', '[Lecture: Learning through contrast]') sat in the SAME `##` chunk, two lines down (that pin's own recorded rule-1/rule-3 evidence says so explicitly: 'lines 26/28 carry the two lecture links'). This diff inserted new chunk 5 ('## Say what done-done means', raw lines 26-39) between the blockquote that closes chunk 4 and those two links, so the links now render on a DIFFERENT slide, two chunks later. Harm: on the composed 'Start here' slide, a trainer or solo reader sees the sentence promise a lecture 'below' and finds nothing under it but an unrelated 'Long sessions, short reads' aside — the actual lecture (its name not yet given either) surfaces only after an entire intervening 'Say what done-done means' slide, with no cue tying the two together. This is the textbook shape of the rule's own canonical failure (prework's 'the repo itself (picked in Step 1 below)' stranded three slides ahead of Step 1). Not maintainer-attested: the file's one 'Slide deixis accepted' note (raw line 149) covers a different phrase ('the bullets back', a verb phrase) and the new 'Done-done opener' note (raw line 124) documents the insertion's placement and pedagogy but never addresses this side effect on the preceding slide. Mechanical gate `node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file <this file> --report` returns clean, but only because its geometry-object word list omits 'lecture' — confirmed by reading the script (`scripts/check-slide-deixis.js` OBJ regex: prompt/step/phase/section/list/instruction/example/law/rule/block/command/quote/link/table/diagram/note/bullet/paragraph/... — no 'lecture'); the tool's silence is a vocabulary gap, not a clearance.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Drop the geometry claim on this slide: name the thing or use reading order instead of 'below' — e.g. 'the two lectures ahead hand you the lenses' — since the links no longer sit on this slide.
